## Modules

- [MongoosePush](MongoosePush.md): MongoosePush is simple (seriously) service providing ability to send push
notification to `FCM` (Firebase Cloud Messaging) and/or
`APNS` (Apple Push Notification Service). What makes it cool is not only
simplicity but also support for newest and fastest `HTTP/2` based APIs
for both services.
- [MongoosePushWeb.HealthcheckController](MongoosePushWeb.HealthcheckController.md)

- API
  - [MongoosePush.API](MongoosePush.API.md)
  - [MongoosePush.API.V1.ResponseEncoder](MongoosePush.API.V1.ResponseEncoder.md): Module for handling internal responses to V1 HTTP2 codes

  - [MongoosePush.API.V2.ResponseEncoder](MongoosePush.API.V2.ResponseEncoder.md): Module for handling internal responses to V2 HTTP2 codes

  - [MongoosePush.API.V3.ResponseEncoder](MongoosePush.API.V3.ResponseEncoder.md): Module for handling internal responses to V3 HTTP2 codes

- Configuration
  - [MongoosePush.Config.Utils](MongoosePush.Config.Utils.md)

- Logs format
  - [MongoosePush.Logger.Common](MongoosePush.Logger.Common.md): Common logs formatters' helper functions

  - [MongoosePush.Logger.JSON](MongoosePush.Logger.JSON.md): Module responsible for JSON-specific logs formatting

  - [MongoosePush.Logger.LogFmt](MongoosePush.Logger.LogFmt.md): Module responsible for FMT-specific logs formatting

- Metrics
  - [MongoosePush.Metrics.TelemetryMetrics](MongoosePush.Metrics.TelemetryMetrics.md): Module responsible for updating `Telemetry` metrics

- Push notification services
  - [MongoosePush.Service](MongoosePush.Service.md): Generic interface for push notifications services.

  - [MongoosePush.Service.APNS](MongoosePush.Service.APNS.md): APNS (apple Push Notification Service) service provider implementation.

  - [MongoosePush.Service.APNS.ErrorHandler](MongoosePush.Service.APNS.ErrorHandler.md): Module responsible for handling errors returned by APNS service

  - [MongoosePush.Service.APNS.State](MongoosePush.Service.APNS.State.md): Module for storing state of apns APNS configurations, namely default topics

  - [MongoosePush.Service.APNS.Supervisor](MongoosePush.Service.APNS.Supervisor.md): APNS module supervising Sparrow's PoolSupervisor and APNS State

  - [MongoosePush.Service.FCM](MongoosePush.Service.FCM.md): FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) service provider implementation.

  - [MongoosePush.Service.FCM.ErrorHandler](MongoosePush.Service.FCM.ErrorHandler.md): Module responsible for handling errors returned by FCM service.

  - [MongoosePush.Service.FCM.Pool.Supervisor](MongoosePush.Service.FCM.Pool.Supervisor.md): This module is responsible for setting up Sparrow's FCM Supervisor

  - [MongoosePush.Service.FCM.Pools](MongoosePush.Service.FCM.Pools.md): This module is responsible for worker pools management. It provides several
utility functions that help with e.g. selecting workers for given pool of the
service.

- Web
  - [MongoosePushWeb](MongoosePushWeb.md): The entrypoint for defining your web interface, such
as controllers, views, channels and so on.
  - [MongoosePushWeb.APIv1.NotificationController](MongoosePushWeb.APIv1.NotificationController.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.APIv2.NotificationController](MongoosePushWeb.APIv2.NotificationController.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.APIv3.NotificationController](MongoosePushWeb.APIv3.NotificationController.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.ApiSpec](MongoosePushWeb.ApiSpec.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Endpoint](MongoosePushWeb.Endpoint.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.PrometheusMetricsController](MongoosePushWeb.PrometheusMetricsController.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Router](MongoosePushWeb.Router.md)

- Protocols and plugs
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Plug.CastAndValidate](MongoosePushWeb.Plug.CastAndValidate.md): Module plug that serves as a wrapper for OpenApiSpex.Plug.CastAndValidate plug,
to overcome difficulties with proper message validating. For more details,
please refer to update_schema_and_do_call/2 function comment.

  - [MongoosePushWeb.Plug.CastAndValidate.StubAdapter](MongoosePushWeb.Plug.CastAndValidate.StubAdapter.md): Module which is an almost empty Plug.Conn.Adapter behavior implementation.
It is used by the MongoosePushWeb.Plug.CastAndValidate plug
as part of the workaround this module introduces.

  - [MongoosePushWeb.Plug.MaybePutSwaggerUI](MongoosePushWeb.Plug.MaybePutSwaggerUI.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Plug.MaybeRenderSpec](MongoosePushWeb.Plug.MaybeRenderSpec.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Protocols.RequestDecoder](MongoosePushWeb.Protocols.RequestDecoder.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Protocols.RequestDecoderHelper](MongoosePushWeb.Protocols.RequestDecoderHelper.md)

- Schemas
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.md)
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.AlertNotification](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.AlertNotification.md): Request.SendNotification.Deep.AlertNotification
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.Common.Alert](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.Common.Alert.md): Request.SendNotification.Deep.Common.Alert
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.Common.Data](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.Common.Data.md): Request.SendNotification.Deep.Common.Data
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.MixedNotification](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.MixedNotification.md): Request.SendNotification.Deep.MixedNotification
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.SilentNotification](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.Deep.SilentNotification.md): Request.SendNotification.Deep.SilentNotification
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.FlatNotification](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Request.SendNotification.FlatNotification.md): Request.SendNotification.FlatNotification
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Response.SendNotification.GenericError](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Response.SendNotification.GenericError.md): Response.SendNotification.GenericError
  - [MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Response.SendNotification.Gone](MongoosePushWeb.Schemas.Response.SendNotification.Gone.md): Response.SendNotification.Gone
